project.name: line-widget
project.description: FNAL Line widget for Phoebus displays: a simple two-endpoint straight-line connector, easier to draw than Polyline (which requires manual multi-point editing after the initial rubber-band drag). Dragging out the widget in the editor immediately draws a diagonal line across the drawn rectangle; resizing the widget's bounding box moves the line endpoints just like any other simple shape widget (Rectangle, Ellipse, ...). Registers a brand new widget type ("fnal_line") via the standard WidgetsService / WidgetRepresentationsService SPI, so it does not conflict with or shadow any existing widget (see byte-monitor-labels for the shadowing pattern used when patching existing widgets instead).
